name: Giorgia Meloni: The Power of the Clans
original_name: Giorgia Meloni et le clan des Goélands
overview: She is Italy’s most powerful woman and the first right-wing populist to lead a European democracy. Tough at home, moderate abroad, she has been firmly in government for three years, a long time in Italian politics. Who is Giorgia Meloni, and how has she been so successful? The answer lies in the tight clan she has been part of since her youth…
